title: RTK token-savings synergy
description: Rewrites a verbose Bash command to the local, offline `rtk` proxy before it runs, so output reaching the context window is 60-90% smaller. Ships the rtk-savings skill + /rtk command; the hook is inert when rtk is not on PATH.

hooks.name: rtk-hook
hooks.command: sh -c 'command -v rtk >/dev/null 2>&1 && exec rtk hook claude || true'
hooks.why: Optional RTK token savings. Rewrites a verbose Bash command to its token-optimised rtk proxy before it runs (60-90% smaller output). Registry-appended after the safety guards, so a denied command is never rewritten. Inert when rtk is not on PATH. See the rtk-savings skill; read savings with /rtk.

notes: RTK synergy enabled. Install rtk (github.com/dhamidi/rtk) on PATH to activate; inert otherwise. Read savings with /rtk.
